method: Generated v1 PNGs directly inspected using view_image.
For every available per-slug public reference, that reference image was also opened using view_image.
Compared pose identity, decisive contacts, visible limb continuity, approved character costume and assigned poseBrief/keyChecks.
Natural occlusion alone was not treated as a missing limb. A hidden defining hook/grip may still be insufficient for reliable technique illustration.
No raw image, source frame, registry, application manifest, database, task history or application code was modified.
alphaScope: Raw hidden RGB/alpha fringe is not a pose failure. Actual charcoal composition was not repeated here; the parent and previous four-image review already verified that pipeline. This report makes no additional app-rendering claim.
